verdict.rationale: Rollbar's first-party docs describe Resolve, an AI agent that takes a production error and produces a pull request for review (rollbar-docs-17). The homepage says it writes a tested fix and opens the PR for the user to approve (rollbar-docs-48), which matches the story directly. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of repo/SCM integration setup and supported providers, explanation of how fixes are tested, and independent or hands-on corroboration of PR quality.
